resources.string: Transparent, controllable NFC-F profile emulation for Android.

AimeSimulator is an Android NFC-F / FeliCa Lite profile manager and HCE-F emulator. It stores local card profiles, captures the required data from physical cards, and presents the selected profile through Android’s NFC service.

• Multiple local profiles and physical-card capture
• Normal and compatibility NFCID2 routing
• Standard HCE-F PMm declaration
• Optional LSPosed / KernelSU vendor compatibility patches
• Material You dynamic colors and light/dark themes

Profiles remain in the app’s private storage. Android backup is disabled, and the app requests no network permission and includes no telemetry, account, or cloud sync. Hiding an IDm or printed Access Code affects only its display.

Use only with cards and devices you own or are authorized to test. Selecting this app as the default NFC app replaces the existing contactless payment app. Root, LSPosed, and KernelSU patches also modify the NFC runtime; keep a recovery path available.

This app is intended for profile management, compatibility testing, and local debugging on personal devices. Aime, FeliCa, and related names and marks belong to their respective owners. This unofficial tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

After testing, use “Restore wallet app” on the Status page and select your wallet again.

Merge keeps profiles already on this device and updates matching backup IDs. Replace removes all current profiles first. A changed or replaced current profile is deselected so importing cannot silently change the active card.

The APK declares the compatible PMm through Android HCE-F. Enable this fallback patch only when the device ignores or replaces that value. Android 15 and later use the bundled KernelSU module; earlier releases use the Xposed framework hook.
Allows dynamic NFC-F identifiers and applies the optional PMm compatibility value.
